meta.clock: tau = median tick at the full batch (cheap weights); load 1 = cap/(16 tau) arrivals per s (fixed depth 16 at full batch exactly busy); deadline = delta x tau s after arrival; latency in loops = s / tau
meta.cost_caveat: an 8-bit finishing loop and a dither re-draw are charged their real tick time on this GPU (same fp32 kernels for cheap and master weights), not E9's r = 8/b_eff
meta.hit: answer (at departure, or the last in-time state at the deadline) correct and produced by the deadline; fifo answers only at loop 16; dropped arrivals (pool full, fifo cannot finish) are misses
meta.platform: datacenter GPU (not edge), one exclusive card; clocks not pinned
